from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReportEntry(BaseModel):
    """A record of a specific financial metric extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric line item (e.g., '公允价值变动收益')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the value (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReportEntry]
